metaTitle: Custom Frosted Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted badge ID holders for a sleek, professional look. Perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Frosted badge ID holders offer a subtle, professional appearance that reduces glare and fingerprints compared to clear holders. The translucent finish is ideal for corporate environments where a clean, modern look matters. These holders work well with horizontal or vertical ID cards and can be customized with your logo or text through screen printing or debossing. Durable and lightweight, they are a practical choice for daily use in offices, hospitals, or trade shows.
heroAltText: Custom frosted badge ID holders with horizontal orientation and debossed logo, ideal for corporate ID cards.
